title: Locally Lipschitz maps on open subsets of ℝⁿ send Lⁿ-null sets to Hⁿ-null sets (fact F2)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N be locally Lipschitz on V (every u ∈ V has a neighbourhood within V on which ψ is Lipschitz). Let Z ⊆ V have Lebesgue (outer) measure Lⁿ(Z) = 0. Then Hⁿ(ψ(Z)) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V Z : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → LocallyLipschitzOn V ψ → Z ⊆ V → volume Z = 0 → μHE[n] (ψ '' Z) = 0
